title: BUGFIX — hook_timing QC failures: listicle end_s=3 and 60s template end_s=4 violate <=2s gate
rationale: QC gate requires hook_end_s <= 2s (TikTok hook must grab in first 2s). Two codepaths violate this: (1) buildListicleSegments in scs001-script/index.ts sets hook.end_s=3, causing 100% QC failure for listicle template (~25% of videos). (2) 60s template in scs001-script/length-optimizer.ts sets hook:[0,4], causing 100% QC failure for deep-dive videos. Both fixes: change hook end to 2s and shift following segments accordingly.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-script/index.ts buildListicleSegments: change hook end_s from 3 to 2, adjust point segment start_s from 3 to 2.
In agents/scs001-script/length-optimizer.ts 60s case: change hook from [0,4] to [0,2], context from [4,12] to [2,12].
